cards.zh: 先回滚，回头再查原因
cards.en: Let's [[roll back]] first and dig in after.
cards.mine: Let's rollback first, then find the reason.
cards.note: 动词是 roll back，名词才连写

cards.zh: 线上挂了，大家先上个会
cards.en: Prod's down, can everyone [[jump on a call]]?
cards.mine: Production is dead, everyone please join the meeting.

cards.zh: 我们还在排查
cards.en: We're still [[looking into]] it.
cards.mine: We are still checking the problem.

cards.zh: 已经止血了，根因还在查
cards.en: It's [[mitigated]], but we're still chasing root cause.
cards.mine: We already stopped bleeding, but still finding the root cause.
cards.note: 止血用 mitigate 更地道

cards.zh: 我本地能复现
cards.en: I can [[reproduce]] it locally.
cards.mine: I can repeat this problem locally.
cards.note: 口语也常缩写成 repro

cards.zh: 你接 on-call 之前我们交接一下
cards.en: Let's do [[the handover]] before you go on call.
cards.mine: Let me transfer the on-call to you.

us.en: Let's do [[the handoff]] before you go on call.

cards.zh: 我昨晚三点被叫起来了
cards.en: I got [[paged]] at 3am last night.
cards.mine: I was called up at 3am last night.
cards.note: called up 是被征召的意思

cards.zh: 这个告警太吵了
cards.en: This alert is [[way too noisy]].
cards.mine: This alarm is too loud.
cards.note: 告警太多叫 noisy，不是 loud

cards.zh: 小建议，不影响合并
cards.en: [[Nit]]: maybe rename this variable.
cards.mine: Small suggestion, not important: maybe rename this variable.
cards.note: nit 表示小意见，不阻塞合并

cards.zh: 这个改动太大了，能拆开吗？
cards.en: Could you [[split this up]] into smaller PRs?
cards.mine: Can you separate this PR to some small PRs?
cards.note: 拆成几份用 into

cards.zh: 我看没问题，批了
cards.en: [[LGTM]], approved.
cards.mine: I agree this PR.
cards.note: LGTM = looks good to me

cards.zh: 大概要多久，给个粗略估计？
cards.en: Can you give me [[a ballpark]] on this?
cards.mine: Can you give me a rough time estimation?
cards.note: ballpark 指粗略估计

cards.zh: 这是技术债，迟早要还
cards.en: That's [[tech debt]] we'll need to [[pay down]].
cards.mine: This is technical debt, we need to return it later.
cards.note: 还债用 pay down / pay off

cards.zh: 这个不在这次的范围内
cards.en: That's [[out of scope]] for this sprint.
cards.mine: This is not in this time's range.

cards.zh: 要是加这个需求，上线就得推迟
cards.en: If we take that on, the release will [[slip]].
cards.mine: If we add this requirement, the release must delay.
cards.note: 进度往后拖，口语说 slip

cards.zh: 周五下午别上线
cards.en: Let's not [[push to prod]] on a Friday arvo.
cards.mine: Don't go online on Friday afternoon.
cards.note: 上线不是 go online

us.en: Let's not [[push to prod]] on a Friday afternoon.

cards.zh: 在我电脑上是好的啊
cards.en: It [[works on my machine]].
cards.mine: On my side it is okay.
cards.note: 程序员经典梗

cards.zh: 那个测试时好时坏
cards.en: That test is [[flaky]].
cards.mine: That test is unstable sometimes.
cards.note: 时好时坏的测试叫 flaky

cards.zh: 周六谁能帮我顶一下 on-call？
cards.en: Can someone [[cover]] my on-call shift on Saturday?
cards.mine: Can someone replace my on-call on Saturday?
cards.note: 替班用 cover

cards.zh: 这次得做个复盘
cards.en: We should do [[a post-mortem]] on this.
cards.mine: We should do a review meeting for this accident.
cards.note: 事故用 incident，不说 accident

cards.zh: 这只是个临时方案
cards.en: It's just a [[band-aid]] fix for now.
cards.mine: This is only a temporary repairing.
cards.note: 治标不治本的临时修复

cards.zh: 修复已经上了，我在盯着监控
cards.en: The fix is out, I'm [[watching the dashboards]].
cards.mine: The fix is released, I'm watching on it.
cards.note: watch 后面不加 on

cards.zh: 这个时间线我得提点异议
cards.en: I'm going to [[push back]] on that timeline.
cards.mine: I can't accept this timeline.
cards.note: push back 礼貌地表示反对

cards.zh: 出问题的话影响范围多大？
cards.en: What's the [[blast radius]] if this goes wrong?
cards.mine: What's the influence range if it fails?

cards.zh: 能不能先把这个功能开关关掉？
cards.en: Can we just [[turn]] the feature flag [[off]]?
cards.mine: Can we close the feature switch?
cards.note: 关开关用 turn off，不用 close
